This self-reflection can lead to greater self-awareness, personal growth, and a deeper understanding of what is right and wrong. 4. **Accountability and responsibility**: Having a guiding text can also foster a sense of accountability and responsibility, as individuals may feel more inclined to consider the potential consequences of their actions and strive to make choices that align with their values and principles. 5. **Cultivating wisdom and discernment**: Regularly engaging with a guiding text can help individuals develop wisdom and discernment, enabling them to better navigate complex situations and make more informed decisions. In your case, returning to the Quran and Hadith when facing difficulties can provide a sense of comfort, guidance, and direction.
